proposal.reason: Primary change adds new host one-sided RMA APIs (pcclPutSignal/pcclSignal/pcclWaitSignal) plus a new RMA subsystem (src/rma/*), which is outside explicit catalog scopes, so it is classified as other. enqueue is independently substantive because planner/task/launch flow now handles RMA task types, per-context queues, batching, and cleanup. copy-engine is independently substantive because RMA execution is implemented via CE/DMA stream ops, signal/ack memory windows, and wait/write synchronization. communicator is independently substantive due to numRmaCtx config parsing/defaulting, host-RMA capability negotiation across ranks, and communicator property/lifecycle integration.
